independence: Prior U09 independent audit participation only. No U10 plan, design, product, test authorship or execution participation. Read-only inspection and independent hash/data checks; only new audit artifacts written. Root summaries are inputs, not verdicts.

findings.title: Actual normal-basic equipment counter with an active causal subscriber is not demonstrated
findings.observation: ancestry_active executes a normal basic hit 10 and relic echo 7. CausalWorld::prepare uses the starter equipment helper and does not equip a defender counter; the oracle is target loss17 and contains no simultaneous counter-source/attacker-loss oracle. death_chain tests equipment death eligibility without a causal relic. Existing final46 passive/reflection tests also use the old no-relic fixture. These separate successes do not demonstrate the explicitly promised coexistence. The selected evidence was searched across all groups, not just a test name.
findings.source_boundary: The new actual HP-loss observer and inherited causal source in existing trigger delivery join old basic/equipment semantics; unchanged legacy tests alone cannot prove this new combination.
findings.owner: Root coordinates; independent test Astra authors oracle and fixture; Sol executes fixed selectors. Product owner only if a real failure appears.
findings.required_closure: One normal published-relic battle must execute the real basic producer with defender counter equipment and active subscriber together. Assert original/counter/child HP, actor/target/source and counts; no incoming-damage amplification or recreated basic/hit proc/reflection loop, and dead/missing-attacker guards at the affected boundary. Preserve existing positive controls. Bind exact source, selector, raw result and coverage; freeze successor target and request independent re-audit.

findings.title: Actual Corrosion with an active causal owner and optional relic reactions is not demonstrated
findings.observation: The selected r09_public_equipment_death_reactions_are_suppressed_only_for_corrosion and r09_corrosion_faults use native_action_fixture plus skills/fragments/equipment, with no relic/effective causal owner. Thus runtime_facts.causal is None and the new corrosion.rs causal.is_some() branch, inherited context and suppressed causal root are not exercised. The U10 equipment death-chain fixture also has no causal relic. Ordinary ancestry/death tests do not enter Corrosion.
findings.source_boundary: corrosion.rs154-156 creates a suppression-carrying causal root only when causal state exists; death_runtime dispatch=false and relic_causal payload suppression are new affected consumers. Source review supports intent but cannot replace the required actual comparison.
findings.owner: Root coordinates; independent test Astra authors oracle and fixture; Sol executes fixed selectors. Product owner only if a real failure appears.
findings.required_closure: Publish and activate normal relic Death/Kill/AllyDeath subscribers with observable queued/delayed reactions. First prove the reactions under a normal kill. Then cause actual Corrosion with causal state present and assert mandatory death/wave/facts/cost remain while optional equipment/relic reactions stay absent after queue drain, including suppression on applicable derived context. Keep unrelated previously released effects as a control against blanket suppression. Bind exact source/raw and changed predecessor predicates; freeze successor and independently re-audit.

not_findings: Absence of a whole-suite rerun is not by itself a failure.
No product defect is inferred from either evidence gap.
Measured authorized default16 and exact causal-empty fixed cost are not unapproved contract changes.
